title: 酒店房间有问题
subtitle_en: There's a problem with my room.
goal_text: 在前台说清房间问题，拿到换房或延迟退房的处理结果。
brief_cn: 房间出问题不是吵架，是要结果。这一课练四步：说清哪里坏了；问清什么时候修好；提出能接受的方案（修或换）；最后要一个时间点或一点补偿。

vocab.example_en: There's a problem with my room.
There's also noise from the next room.
And there's no hot water either.
Can I change to another room?
Could you send someone up now?

briefing.cn_prompt: 跟我读这句开场，先摊问题。
briefing.ref_text: There's a problem with my room.
briefing.accept_notes: There's 连读，problem 重音在前，整句降调。
air conditioning 三个音节别吞，doesn't work 收尾清楚。

briefing.cn_prompt: 听一遍，用自己的话说出问题和他要做的处理。
briefing.ref_text: The air conditioning doesn't work, and there is no hot water. Please send someone up.
briefing.translation_cn: 空调不工作，也没有热水。请派人上来看看。
briefing.reference_answer: The AC doesn't work and there's no hot water, so please send someone up.
briefing.accept_notes: 说到两处故障并提出要人上来，即算通过。

briefing.cn_prompt: 说成英文：追问处理时间。
briefing.accept_notes: When will it be fixed? 或直接问 What time can you fix it?

briefing.cn_prompt: 说成英文：提出你的替代方案。
briefing.ref_text: 我可以换到另一个房间吗？
briefing.reference_answer: Can I change to another room?
briefing.accept_notes: change to another room，问句形式，升调收尾。

briefing.cn_prompt: 用 late 说一句：争取延迟退房。
briefing.accept_notes: 说出 late check-out 即算通过，句式不限。

mission.persona_cn: 酒店夜班前台，会道歉也会给方案
mission.context_cn: 晚上十一点，你的房间空调不制冷、也没有热水。前台会先道歉，再问细节、给出维修时间，并把换房和延迟退房的选项摆出来——你要自己开口选一个。
mission.opening_a: Good evening. How can I help you?

exchanges.a: Good evening. How can I help you?
exchanges.b: There's a problem with my room.

exchanges.a: I'm sorry. What is the problem?

exchanges.b: Yes, and there's no hot water either.

exchanges.a: I can send someone up tonight.
An engineer can come in ten minutes, but I can't promise.
exchanges.b: Can I change to another room?
exchanges.a_cn: 工程师十分钟能上去，但我不敢保证。

exchanges.a: Yes. I can move you to a quiet room on a high floor.
exchanges.b: Please make sure it has hot water.
exchanges.a_cn: 可以，给您换一间高层安静房。

exchanges.a: Of course. I'll also give you a late check-out.
exchanges.b: Great. Is a late check-out until two?
exchanges.a_cn: 没问题，再给您一个延迟退房。
exchanges.b_cn: 好，延迟退房可以到两点吗？

tasks.desc_cn: 说清至少一个具体故障（空调、热水或噪音）
tasks.hint_cn: 直接说哪样东西 doesn't work，别绕。

tasks.desc_cn: 请前台派人处理，并问清什么时候修好
tasks.hint_en: Could you send someone up, and when will it be fixed?
tasks.hint_cn: 两句话：先请人上来，再问时间。

tasks.desc_cn: 提出换到另一间房这个方案
tasks.hint_en: Can I change to another room?
tasks.hint_cn: 给前台一个他能马上执行的方案。

tasks.desc_cn: 为这晚的不便争取一点补偿（延迟退房）
tasks.hint_cn: 补偿不用不好意思，问 until what time。
